risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit concentration among certain customers, with two customers representing 13.7% and 8.4% of total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025, compared to 13.7% and 6.1% as of December 28, 2024. This concentration is due to extended payment terms common in the industry.

risks.title: Control Failure Risk
risks.score_rationale: Internal controls and disclosure controls are considered effective as of December 31, 2025, but there remains a risk of control failure that could impact the reliability of financial statements.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: No material litigation is mentioned in the 10-K report, but it is still possible that litigation could occur in the future.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation could be affected by negative events, such as quality issues or litigation.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk
risks.score_rationale: Customer concentration among certain customers in North American operations could negatively impact the company's finances if these customers decided to cease doing business with the company.

ai_positioning.summary: GTES has no significant mentions concerning artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts. Its business focuses on the design, manufacturing, and marketing of highly integrated power transmission and fluid power solutions serving diversified markets.
